sents.t: Mr. Lee is opening a second bookstore in Riverside this summer, and he needs an assistant manager for Oakville Books.
Emma said, “You should apply, Sam! You’ve worked here for almost nine months.”
So I updated my résumé and applied.
Mr. Lee knows me well, but he said, “We still have to do a real interview.”
On Wednesday, I wore my light blue shirt and sat across from Mr. Lee and his business partner, Ms. Rivera.
“Have you ever managed a team?” Ms. Rivera asked.
“No, I haven’t, but I have trained two new employees since January, and I’ve organized the children’s story hour every Saturday.”
“My English isn’t perfect yet,” I said honestly.
“But I’ve improved a lot, and I study every day.”
At the end, she asked, “Do you have any questions for us?” I asked about the schedule and the salary.
Two days later, Mr. Lee called me.
